# vote/

_Created: 16-08-2026 · Last updated: 16-08-2026_

Public voting hub for `/review-sheet` HTML cards — see the private Uprava registry
`REVIEW_SHEETS_INDEX.md` for status and source context of every sheet.

**`index.html` is generated by `Uprava/tools/build_vote_hub_index.py` (H2854 step 3) —
do not hand-edit it.** Update `REVIEW_SHEETS_INDEX.md` (Awaiting vote / Decided /
applied tables), run the generator against this hub clone, and commit the result:

```
python tools/build_vote_hub_index.py --hub /path/to/gasyoun.github.io
```

Use `--check` to detect drift between the committed `index.html` and what the
registry+hub state would currently generate (weekly-review use), without writing
anything.

`sheets/*.html` are the individual voting cards themselves, copied here by
`/review-sheet` Phase 3-bis at generation time — those are hand-copied per sheet,
not generated.

_Dr. Mārcis Gasūns_
